children: US Metro Bancorp (OTCQX: USMT) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a $0.04 per share cash dividend, payable on September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 8, 2026.
About US Metro Bancorp, Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiary US Metro Bank

US Metro Bancorp is the holding company for US Metro Bank, a California-chartered, full-service commercial bank headquartered in Garden Grove, California. Founded in 2006, US Metro Bank offers deposit and loan products—including commercial real estate, commercial and industrial, mortgage, and SBA loans—as well as related banking services to its customers.
